origin.origins_winter_fabric.snow_elf.de: Taller than humans and resistant to cold, these graceful elves are native to snowy biomes.
power.origins_winter_fabric.snow_elf.hei: Snow Elves are slightly taller than humans.
power.origins_winter_fabric.snow_elf.col: Your natural affinity with cold environments makes you immune to freezing damage.
power.origins_winter_fabric.snow_elf.hea: Your pale skin burns under direct sunlight. Wear a helmet to protect yourself.
power.origins_winter_fabric.snow_elf.sno: You move faster in snowy biomes and on snow blocks.
power.origins_winter_fabric.snow_elf.fro: Press the primary ability key (configurable to R in Minecraft settings) to create a powerful frost aura with a 10-block radius for 6 seconds, heavily slowing enemies and withering them.
power.origins_winter_fabric.snow_elf.sno: While sneaking, press your secondary ability key to become invisible for 5 seconds.
origin.origins_winter_fabric.crimson_gia: Massive inhabitants of the Nether's crimson forests, these giants stand two and a half blocks tall and possess tremendous strength.
power.origins_winter_fabric.crimson_gian: Crimson Giants stand two and a half blocks tall with an exceptionally wide build. Your long arms allow you to reach blocks from further away, your long strides make you move faster, and your powerful legs let you jump higher.
Your powerful legs allow you to jump up to two blocks high.
Your immense size grants you increased attack damage.
You are immune to fire and lava damage.
Crimson fungi provide more nourishment for you.
Your body is adapted to the Nether's heat. You take damage in cold environments, snow, and when exposed to rain.
origin.origins_winter_fabric.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origin.origins_winter_fabric.dwarf.descr: Short and sturdy cave dwellers with unparalleled mining abilities and night vision in dark places.
power.origins_winter_fabric.dwarf.height: Dwarves are significantly shorter than humans.
power.origins_winter_fabric.dwarf.mining: You mine stone and ore blocks 50% faster than other races.
power.origins_winter_fabric.dwarf.stone_: Your sturdy body takes 30% less damage from falling and falling blocks.
power.origins_winter_fabric.dwarf.night_: Your eyes are adapted to seeing in dark caves and underground.
power.origins_winter_fabric.dwarf.cave_d: You feel stronger and healthier underground or in darkness, gaining 2 hearts of extra health.
